name: error-search-trgm-mode-rejected-when-not-declared
$comment: FM-30 (trigram search, phase 2): mode: "trgm" against a search index that never declared trgm: true is rejected as BAD_REQUEST naming the missing declaration, not a silent fallback to a sequential ILIKE scan. Mirrors server search_test::trgm_mode_rejected_when_not_declared and each client's in-memory port of the same gate.
